title: Multi-Collider
description: Attaches one or more collision shapes to a single entity. Use Multi-Collider to combine solid physics bounds, trigger zones, attack hitboxes, and damage hurtboxes on one entity.

blocks.content: The **Collider** component in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector) supports multiple independent collision shapes on a single [entity](components/entities_and_prefabs). Instead of creating extra child entities, you can give one character a solid capsule for walking, a hurtbox for taking damage, and an offset hitbox for melee attacks.

items.title: Multiple Shapes
items.desc: Add as many named colliders as you need inside one **Collider** component.

items.title: Capsule Rounding
items.desc: Increase **Corner Radius (Capsule)** to round box corners for smooth movement over edges and slopes.

items.title: Auto Flip & Fit
items.desc: Automatically mirror offset hitboxes when an entity flips horizontally, or lock size to the transform.

items: Select an entity in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) or [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport).
In the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), click **Add Component...** under **Actions** and choose **Collider**.
To add another shape to the same entity, click the 3-dots button next to the **Attached Colliders** dropdown and select **Add Collider**.

blocks.message: To see collider wireframes on the canvas, press **Esc** to clear your selection and check **Show Collider Solid Bounds**, **Trigger Bounds**, **Hitbox Bounds**, or **Hurtbox Bounds** under **Quick Actions** in the **Property Inspector**.

blocks.content: Select a shape from the **Attached Colliders** dropdown at the top of the **Collider** section to edit its properties.

rows: Dropdown that switches which collider shape on the entity you are currently editing.
Unique identifier for this specific shape so visual scripts can target it by name.
Toggles **Enabled** or **Disabled** for this individual collider shape.
Role of the shape: **Solid (Physics)** blocks movement, **Trigger (Zone)** detects overlaps without blocking, **Hitbox (Attack)** deals damage, and **Hurtbox (Damage Zone)** receives damage.
Pixel offset from the entity's position.
Width (**W**) and height (**H**) of the collider box in pixels.
Rounds the corners of the box into a capsule or circle (up to half of the smaller side).
Local rotation in degrees (0 to 359) and 3x3 origin pivot for the collider.
Locks the collider's size, offset, rotation, and pivot to match the entity's [Transform & UI Transform](components/transform) automatically.
Keeps the collider upright in world space even when the entity rotates (ideal for characters with slope alignment).
Automatically mirrors horizontal **Offset (X)** when the entity flips left or right.

blocks.content: Set up a character with both a solid physics capsule and an attack hitbox on the same **Collider** component.

items: Select your character entity and add a **Collider** component.
Keep the first collider's **Script ID** as **col_solid_1**, set **Type** to **Solid (Physics)**, and increase **Corner Radius (Capsule)** so the bottom corners are rounded.
Click the 3-dots button next to **Attached Colliders** and click **Add Collider**.
Set the new collider's **Script ID** to **col_sword_hitbox** and change **Type** to **Hitbox (Attack)**.
Set **Offset** **X** to **24** so the hitbox sits in front of the character, and keep **Auto Flip with Facing / flipX** checked so it flips when the character turns.

blocks.content: Use the nodes in [Physics & Collision](node_library/game_physics) and [Helper & Tool](node_library/helper_tool) to detect collisions, triggers, and combat hits by **Script ID**.

rows: Checks for physical collisions against **Solid (Physics)** colliders and solid tilemaps.
Fires **onEnter**, **onStay**, and **onExit** when entities overlap a **Trigger**, **Hitbox**, or **Hurtbox** shape.
Enables, disables, resizes, or updates a specific collider shape by its **Script ID** at runtime.
Casts a line of sight ray to detect colliders along a direction.
Activates attack **Hitbox** colliders during melee combos and detects hits against enemy **Hurtbox** shapes.
**Fit to Transform Size & Rotation** is checked. Uncheck it to enter custom dimensions or offsets.
Character snags on seams between floor tiles
Increase **Corner Radius (Capsule)** on the character's **Solid (Physics)** collider so its bottom edges are slightly rounded.
Deleting a collider removes all shapes on the entity

Use the 3-dots menu next to the **Attached Colliders** dropdown and click **Remove Current** to delete only the selected shape. **Remove All Colliders** in the top section header removes the entire component.
You want the entity to respond to gravity, velocity, and solid collisions.
